import pandas as pd

products = pd.read_csv("products.csv", index_col="product_id")

grinder_price = products.loc[7, "unit_price"]

subset = products.loc[[11, 21, 37], ["name", "unit_cost"]]

by_price = products.sort_values("unit_price", ascending=False)
top5 = by_price.iloc[:5]

cheapest_name = by_price.iloc[-1]["name"]

checks.test: isinstance(subset, pd.DataFrame) and list(subset.index) == [11, 21, 37] and list(subset.columns) == ['name', 'unit_cost']
isinstance(top5, pd.DataFrame) and len(top5) == 5 and list(top5['unit_price']) == [449, 329, 289, 199, 189]
